bio.text: Andrew Beck, a Democrat, is running against Republican Rep. Scott Fitzgerald for Wisconsin's 5th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to the Wisconsin Examiner's general election voter guide, Beck lives in West Bend and has worked in product development for GE Healthcare and as an MRI technologist and sales manager.
